summary: List Current Revision for External RFIs filter options
description: Returns a list of available Current Revision filter fields and options for External RFIs

key.description: Boolean filter value. When `true`, filters to current-revision external RFIs only. Pass as `filters[current_revision]=true` when filtering.

value.description: Human-readable label for the option, translated to the current locale (e.g. `Yes`).
